title: kb_backlog serves the read-only commands managers run most (held, referrers, find, similar, tree, config, landings, runs, procs, check, report), and a finding's exit 1 returns as text
goal: kb_backlog accepts held, referrers, find, similar, tree, config, landings, runs, procs, check and report and refuses runs --reconcile; an exit 1 of find, held or report that carries its finding in stdout returns as text ending (exit 1), not as a tool error

clauses.clause: kb_backlog accepts held, referrers, find, similar, tree, config, landings, runs, procs, check and report and refuses runs --reconcile
an exit 1 of find, held or report that carries its finding in stdout returns as text ending (exit 1), not as a tool error

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: 1,537 Bash calls in 231 sessions in 7 days: held 551 (70 sessions, nearly all 'held --overlaps ID --ref origin/main'), check 414 (123 sessions, median 4.3 s), referrers 191 (132 sessions, 81 exit 1 = strays found), find 126 (42 exit 1 = no hit), config 108, runs 87, tree 35, procs 29, landings 11, similar 5; by role: manager and main 853, orchestrators 430, workers 254. kb_backlog allows only show, list, next, horizon, stalled, cost, ops and selectors (kb_mcp.py:1241), so a call of held, referrers or find is refused as 'not read-only here'; it also turns any non-zero exit into a tool error (kb_mcp.py:1276-1277) where facade_run keeps an exit-1 finding as text (kb_mcp.py:1443-1448): 137 'Exit code 1' banners in the week were findings. Each of the ten is read-only in code (bl_view.cmd_held, find, tree, similar; bl_items.cmd_referrers; bl_base.cmd_config; bl_ops.cmd_landings; bl_check.cmd_check; bl_runs.cmd_runs without --reconcile, which writes coord; bl_procs.cmd_procs); host-check, precheck, researched and selfcheck run item checks or write and stay off. No output tokens are saved: the value is uniform access and an honest exit status. Caveat: check (4.3 s median) and referrers (3.1 s) run in the one-request server process (ST-qeespjim). Adoption is the open risk (ST-uruhigy4). Planning 2026-10-24: report joins the list (ST-ejmb5aqn, sprint 1, moved its kb_backlog serving here); the skill, role file and brief that list the commands are one story of this sprint (the route consumers). Started 2026-10-25 with SP-fkep6hjx on the operator approval "start them" (unattended run).
